name: school-bus-tracking
description: Production-grade, multi-tenant School Bus Tracking SaaS platform

scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/shared-types run build && npm --prefix packages/design-tokens run build && npm --prefix packages/config run build && npm --prefix packages/validation run build && npm --prefix packages/api-client run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test && npm --prefix apps/mobile test
scripts.clean: rimraf dist build .next .expo apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/.expo packages/*/dist
